records.label: spacr.qt.job_runner#3
records.source: ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted **on the worker thread**. A closure connected to it is invoked there and must not touch widgets. Connecting the signal to a bound method of a GUI-thread QObject lets Qt queue the call onto the GUI thread; this runner uses ``_worker_finished`` for that delivery. A worker-thread slot can also relay a ``Signal`` to such a receiver without touching widgets itself.
records.context: ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted **on the background execution unit**. A closure connected to it is invoked there and must not touch widgets. Connecting the signal to a bound method of a main GUI execution path QObject lets Qt schedule the call onto the main GUI execution path; this runner uses ``_worker_finished`` for that delivery. A background execution unit slot can also relay a ``Signal`` to such a receiver without touching widgets itself.
records.translation: ``PipelineWorker.finished`` **在工作线程中**发出。连接到它的闭包会在该线程中调用，且不得访问界面控件。将信号连接到 GUI 线程中 QObject 的绑定方法后，Qt 可以将调用排入 GUI 线程的队列；此运行器使用 ``_worker_finished`` 完成该传递。工作线程中的槽也可以将 ``Signal`` 转发给这样的接收者，而不直接访问界面控件。
